mission: Build a production-grade C# platform for autonomous project planning, memory, agents, and secure tool execution.

phases.name: Project Planning
acceptance: The project scope is clear and approved
The timeline is realistic and agreed upon

phases.name: Security Architecture
acceptance: The security requirements are clear and comprehensive
The authentication and authorization system is robust and secure

phases.name: Core Platform Development
acceptance: The core platform components are implemented and tested
The core platform meets the functional requirements

phases.name: Autonomous Project Planning
deliverables: Integration tests for project planning module
acceptance: The autonomous project planning module is implemented and tested
The project planning module meets the functional requirements

phases.name: Memory Management
deliverables: Integration tests for memory management module
acceptance: The memory management module is implemented and tested
The memory management module meets the functional requirements

phases.name: Agents Development
acceptance: The agents module is implemented and tested
The agents module meets the functional requirements

phases.name: Secure Tool Execution
deliverables: Integration tests for secure tool execution module
acceptance: The secure tool execution module is implemented and tested
The secure tool execution module meets the functional requirements

risks.description: Security vulnerabilities in the authentication and authorization system
risks.mitigation: Regular security audits and penetration testing

risks.description: Delays in core platform development due to unforeseen technical issues
risks.mitigation: Daily stand-ups, code reviews, and contingency planning

risks.description: Lack of testing coverage for autonomous project planning module
Inadequate memory management, leading to performance issues
Agents not functioning as expected due to complex logic
Secure tool execution failing due to incorrect configuration
